name: Artillery Genius Pro 0.4 nozzle
pre_gcode: G1 Y0 F5000; Move to front
G1 X0 F5000; Move to origin
M190 S{bed_temp}; wait for the bed to heat up
M109 S{temp}; wait for the extruder to heat up
G1 X20 Y5 Z0.3 F5000.0; move to start-line position
G1 X200 Y5 F1500.0 E15; draw 1st line
G1 X200 Y5.3 Z0.3 F5000.0; move to side a little
G1 X5.3  Y5.3 Z0.3 F1500.0 E30; draw 2nd line
G1 Z3 F3000; move z up little to prevent scratching of surface
post_gcode: G1 E-2 Z0.2 F2400; Retract and raise Z
G1 X5 Y5 F3000; Wipe out
M84 X Y E; Disable all steppers but Z
fan_gcode: M106 S{fan_speed}  ; p3d: add for orca slicer
